new.pl: Dexfield Park, south bank of the South Raccoon River between Dexter and Redfield (Union Twp)
new.st: On 24 July 1933 a posse surprised the Barrow gang camped on the wooded hill above Dexfield Park. Buck Barrow was mortally wounded and Blanche Barrow captured; Clyde Barrow, Bonnie Parker and W. D. Jones escaped. Forum tellings say up to $65,000 in loot was buried near the camp. No period record of any cache has been found, and the gang's known takings were far smaller. Pin circle (600 m) covers the Public Access Area at the NW corner of sec. 9 on the 1982 USGS Redfield topo and the wooded rise just south; not the spot itself.
new.t: The shootout is well documented; the loot is not. Period papers for 25-31 July 1933 (Dexter, Adel, Des Moines) are being read for what money was found on the gang. A 1920s-30s Dallas County plat naming Dexfield Park would tighten the circle. Public access land (state DNR): no digging; look-only.
src: USGS Redfield 7.5' topo, 1982 (Public Access Area, NW corner sec. 9)
pinev: Placed on the 1982 USGS Redfield 7.5' topo: the only public parcel on the south bank between Dexter and Redfield; wide circle pending a plat check.
new.tovw: Lead grade D: forum tale on a real 1933 shootout; no period record of a cache; public land, look only
